desc:
• PROTEIN BARS: Every delicious 90-calorie chocolate fudge flavored protein bar has 10g of protein; A good source of protein

  • KETO FRIENDLY: 1g sugar and 2g net carbs per serving; 2g net carbs = 10g total carb - 5g fiber - 2g sugar alcohol - 1g allulose; Always consult your physician before starting an eating plan that involves regular consumption of high fat foods

  • A GOOD SOURCE OF FIBER: Each serving has 5g fiber (total fat 2.5g, sat. fat 1.5g)

  • SNACK BARS: Feel like one smart cookie when you say 'yes' to your sweet tooth; An ideal office or lunch box snack, part of breakfast, or on the go treat

  • CONTAINS: One 4.8 oz box of Protein One 90 Calorie Chocolate Fudge Protein Bars; 5 bars
features:
Perfect Portion Control

  • At just 90 calories, it satisfies hunger without overdoing intake.

Supports Weight Management & Fitness Goals

  • High protein and fiber help control appetite and support muscle maintenance .

Fits Low‑Carb/Keto Lifestyles

  • Minimal sugar and net carbs make it easy to stay in ketosis or low-carb tracking.

Great Anytime, Anywhere Snack

  • Ideal for breakfast boosts, office snacks, gym fuel, or travel treats.

Enjoyable Taste With Nutritional Value

  • Offers a satisfying chocolate indulgence with beneficial nutrients—no compromise.
ingredients: Soy Protein Isolate, Chicory Root Extract, Whey Protein Isolate, Vegetable Glycerin, Palm and Palm Kernel Oil, Whey Protein Concentrate, Maltitol Syrup, Allulose, Dutch Cocoa (processed with alkali), Calcium Caseinate, Soy Lecithin, Cocoa Powder, Collagen, Salt, Stevia Extract, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Canola Oil.
